name: LSAP
detail: 2023 programme only says it will analyse the possibility of reintroducing a personal wealth tax (EUR 2.6m allowance); Paperjam says it would like to see a return. A study commitment, not a position. Check the programme and the vote on motion 4406.

name: Luxembourg corporate net wealth tax (impôt sur la fortune of companies)
detail: Since 2006 the impôt sur la fortune is owed only by companies (minimum net worth tax); a corporate levy, not a tax on persons wealth. Not counted.
